summary: Django Report Sales app fully tested end-to-end via public preview URL. 27 Django unit tests pass, plus 20 pytest e2e HTTP tests covering login/captcha, SPV dashboard+filters+export, sales scope isolation, kunjungan CRUD (create with new + case-insensitive reuse, edit to CLOSING), cek_instansi AJAX, WA H2 POST → wa.me redirect + timeline update, logout POST-only (405 on GET), admin access, anonymous redirect. Playwright UI verified: SPV dashboard, sales dashboard, cek_instansi AJAX callout showing 'Sudah dikunjungi oleh Maryadi', blast WA page with H0/H2/H5 buttons and green-check indicator for sent H2, logout POST. All data-testids present and reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: Everything solid. Minor: /app/backend/report/forms.py field order & Meta.fields intentionally split model vs non-model fields — well structured.
Case-insensitive uniqueness relies on Instansi.objects.filter(nama__iexact=nama).first() — works; consider a DB-level unique index on lower(nama) for concurrency safety in future PG deploy.

Root path / returns 200 (login HTML) instead of redirecting to /api/login/; not per spec but harmless in preview since /api/login/ is the canonical entrypoint. May want an explicit 302 for cleanliness.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run e2e: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_e2e_api.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 loadscope, override with -n 0 for sequential (tests share module-scoped sessions). Field names in KunjunganForm are `tanggal`, `status`, `catatan` (NOT tanggal_kunjungan/status_pembicaraan). Login CSRF via /api/login/ form, then POST with captcha_0 (hidden hash), captcha_1='PASSED', Referer header, follow allow_redirects=False.
